notes.title: Kakuto Update is Live !!!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]2 brand new characters from the versus fighting scene : Kayane and Ryan Hart.
[*]1 new unlockable character : Freddie
[*]New move accessible to all characters : Parry. Take risks by parrying your adversary moves with the right timing, and inflict more damage.
[*]Tech Jumps : when knocked out in the air, recover at the right time for retaliation !
[*]Kakuto mode : dedicated 1vs1 with customisable settings.
[*]A lot of updates to playables characters.
[/list]

Practice parrying in TRAINING -> PARRY TRAINING

notes.title: Streets of Fury: FURYOUS update is LIVE
notes.content:
This is Streets of Fury EX first big update!

[list]
[*]2 new playable characters : Mr. Quaraté & Bob Lennon
[*]TRAINING mode
[*]Graphics and interface improvements
[*]Speed up (and slow motion) on cut scenes
[*]Customisable HUD
[*]New challenges
[*]Gameplay evolutions:
[list]
[*]More reactive characters: dash/jump cancels, turn around mid combo.
[*]Block and Dodge use less stamina
[*]No more stamina recovery speed penalty when blocking
[*]Combo damage reduction for players
[*]AI tweaks: easier to payback
[*]removed infinite combos
[*]feedback on combo state (when raising a downed opponent)
[*]fury multiplier in versus
[/list]
[/list]

Incoming:
Combo Videos
